## What ships

- **Terms first (A-18).** The published terms text of both boundary sources is
  captured verbatim into rights packets
  (`docs/build/reports/rights/census_gazetteer_tiger.md` — the TIGER/Line 2025
  technical-documentation chapter, sha256 `ce40bee7…` of the downloaded PDF:
  US Government work under 17 U.S.C. §105, citation requested, trademark
  honoured, boundary data statistical and **never** a jurisdictional-authority
  determination — and `natural_earth_10m.md` — the express public-domain
  dedication + "Made with Natural Earth" citation forms). `sources.toml` rows
  carry `captured_terms_verbatim` / `captured_terms_evidence` /
  `publication_basis`; both rows stay explicitly
  `ingestion_permitted = false` (the HG-03 flip is the operator's act, never
  this row's edit).
- **The boundary pack** (`exports/boundary_pack.py` +
  `data/boundary_pack.toml`, the declared `sig.boundary-pack/1` spec — data,
  not code): TIGER/Line state/county/place (containment), Gazetteer
  names/points (enrichment, never key-minting), the 500k cartographic file
  (display only — never containment, K4 §4.1), Natural Earth 10m admin-0/1.
  `sig-exports boundaries build` converts inputs to GeoParquet (WKB + `geo`
  footer metadata via DuckDB `spatial`) and emits the manifest with per-file
  sha256 + a `boundaries_root` content digest. **Fail-closed:** the build
  refuses unless every layer's source is `ingestion_permitted`; fixture
  builds record `gate.mode = "fixture-bypass"` so a fixture pack can never
  pass for a captured one. `verify_pack` re-hashes every file + recomputes
  the root.
- **The jurisdiction registry** (`exports/jurisdictions.py` —
  `sig.jurisdiction-registry/1`, CC-BY-4.0 SIG metadata attributing the
  upstreams): canonical keys `iso3166-1:<A2>` / `iso3166-2:<A2>-<sub>` /
  `us.census.geoid.county:<SSCCC>` / `us.census.geoid.place:<SSPPPPP>` /
  `national:<scheme>:<code>` — a jurisdiction is **never keyed on a bare
  code**. Every other identifier rides as a `(scheme, value, kind)` pair.
  **D-K4-4:** US territories key `iso3166-2:US-*` under `iso3166-1:US`, ISO
  3166-1 codes carried as `kind=alias` identifiers. **D-K4-2:** disputed
  territories take ISO 3166-1 as published (TW, PS, HK, EH), `XK` carries
  `code_status = "user-assigned"`, names are neutral, one standing note — a
  posture, never an adjudication. NE admin-1 for GB rolls up by `geonunit` to
  the ISO 3166-2 first tier (the rollup map is the record); NE US rows mint
  no key (Census is the US admin-1 truth); un-codable rows mint no key —
  recorded, never invented.
- **`lookup@1`** (K4 §5.4): `lookup(name, level=None, within=None)` →
  candidates `{jkey, name, level, score, basis, rules}` — official name 1.0,
  identifier 0.95, alternate 0.9; `within` walks the parent chain
  (inclusive). **Ambiguity returns every candidate** — the consumer records
  `name_ambiguous`; lookup never guesses.
- **Descriptor v2 seam:** `boundaries_root` now derives from the staged,
  verified pack at `<export>/inputs/boundary-pack/` (recompute-and-verify,
  never trust the file); an explicit `--boundaries-root` that disagrees fails
  the build — a contradiction is never signed. No staged pack →
  declared-empty (P35.12 semantics).
- **CLI:** `sig-exports boundaries {build,registry,verify,root,stage,lookup,
  validate}` — all offline, non-zero exits carry the refusal reason.
